_notes.title: The name on the title card. Optional; Tiny Tornado when left out.
_notes.playerName: The person's name, shown on the damage report. Ask for it.
_notes.townName: The town's name, on the title card and painted on the water tower. Up to 24 letters. Ask for it.
_notes.theme: The look: plains (green fields, red barns, a slate sky), dusk (gold light under a purple sky), or snow (a white town in a blue storm). Ask for it.
_notes.seed: Any word; the town's layout is made from it, so the same word gives the same town. Optional; the town name when left out.
_notes.runSeconds: How long the storm lasts, from 15 to 600 seconds. Optional; 60 when left out.
